_readme: Google reviews, copied in by hand. Nothing here is fetched and nothing is
generated: if a review is not in this file it does not appear on the site,
and nothing on the site claims a rating this file does not carry.
TO ADD A REVIEW
1. Open your Google listing and find the review.
2. Copy the reviewer's name, their star rating, the date and their words.
3. Paste them into "items" below, newest first.
4. Update "rating" and "count" to match what Google now shows you.
5. Run `node build.js`, then commit and push.
Copy what the customer wrote exactly. Do not tidy it, do not translate it.
A review written in Bengali stays in Bengali on the English page too,
because that is what the person actually said — and a reader can tell the
difference between a real review and a rewritten one.
FIELDS
rating  Your overall Google score, e.g. 4.8. Use null to hide the
summary line until you have one.
count   Your total number of Google reviews. This is normally larger
than the number of reviews quoted below, which is fine — the
site says 'N reviews on Google' and shows a few of them.
url     Your Google listing, for the 'read them all' link.
items   The reviews to show. Three to six reads best; more than that and
people stop reading.
AN ITEM LOOKS LIKE THIS
"author": "Rahim Uddin",
"rating": 5,
"text": "What they wrote, word for word."
The build refuses to run if a rating is outside 1-5, a date is not
YYYY-MM-DD, or a name or text is empty — so a typo here stops the site
rather than shipping a broken review card.
While "items" is empty the whole section is left out of every page.
